user.title: New biome
user.description: A biome is, for example, a terrarium or a greenhouse. Set the biome day of the first profile. You add devices and more profiles afterwards on the integration's page; the overview is on the [Biome]({panel}) page. A new biome starts in a dry run and does not switch anything yet.

data_description.start_date: Leave empty to choose the profile by hand only.

error.same_times: The day cannot start and end at the same time.

user.title: Profile
user.description: A profile stands for a season with its own biome day. With a start date, Biome switches to the profile on that day every year by itself. The year does not matter.

data_description.start_date: Leave empty to choose the profile by hand only.
data_description.copy_from: Devices you have not yet set up for the new profile run as in this profile.
data_description.transition: Over this many days from the start date, the biome day moves slowly from the previous profile's times to these. 0 changes at once. Which devices run changes on the start date.

profile.description: Biome day in the {profile} profile: {day_start} to {day_end}. The offset moves switching on and off; positive minutes mean later, negative earlier. Example: +15 and −15 switch on 15 minutes after the day starts and off 15 minutes before it ends.
